question: Which classes of beings are listed alongside the deities in this sequence?
premises: Kinnaras, Yakṣas, Nāgas and Vidyādharas are listed.
The address is to the beloved.
inference: Gandharvas, Kinnaras, Yakṣas, Nāgas and Vidyādharas are named here.
plain_english: Gandharvas, Kinnaras, Yakṣas, Nāgas and Vidyādharas, O beloved.
